result.title: A Generic On-Board AI Processing Chain for Earth Observation: From Application Development to Embedded Deployment and Mission-Level Orchestration
result.summary: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向对地观测卫星，构建通用的星载 AI 处理链：将分割模型量化到 int8 并移植到 AMD Versal VCK190，用可复用的切块—推理—拼图流程把瓦片级结果提升到场景级，并以 ORCHIDE 编排各步骤，完成了端到端性能表征。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于遥感星载部署与任务编排工程（量化、硬件移植、并行工作流），虽含视觉分割，但未涉及 VLM 内部状态、latent 推理生成、证据获取或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的实质联系。
